Name: Fat Shane
Author: KarmaWG
Description: I saw a few other fat character mods floating around but couldn't find one for Shane so I spent the day making it myself. New portraits and editted sprites which make him heavy set and a bit taller. I might update it later with changes in dialogue and things like that but for now it's just the portraits, sprites, and the work-uniform sprite set. Feel free to leave suggestions for things to add to this.

Downloads.Description: Exactly what it says on the tin.
